# `surfaces/MediaSurface.js`

> **Source:** `engine/surfaces/MediaSurface.js`

Browser-media producers for RenderSurface. These sources only expose pixels that the caller explicitly supplies or requests; camera capture is never started implicitly and owned MediaStreams are always stopped on dispose.

## Functions

### `createImageSurface(opts = {})`

Wrap an ImageBitmap, image element, canvas, or URL as a static pixel source. URL-created images default to anonymous CORS and expose a `ready` promise.

### `createVideoSurface(opts = {})`

Wrap an HTMLVideoElement or create one from a URL/MediaStream.

### `async createCameraSurface(opts = {})`

Request a camera only after an explicit caller action, then expose it as a video source. The returned source owns and stops every acquired track.
